G2802.def: of uncertain derivation; Claude, an island near Crete:--Clauda.

G2803.def: feminine of «2804»; Claudia, a Christian woman:--Claudia.

G2804.def: of Latin origin; Claudius, the name of two Romans:--Claudius.

G2806.def: a primary verb; to break (specially, of bread):--break.

G2807.def: from «2808»; a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively:--key.

G2808.def: a primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively):--shut (up).

G2809.def: from «2813»; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act):--theft.

G2810.et: probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of (2811) and (3962))
G2810.def: probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of «2811» and «3962»); Cleopas, a Christian:--Cleopas.

G2811.def: from a shorter form of «2564»; renown (as if being called):--glory.

G2812.def: from «2813»; a stealer (literally or figuratively):--thief. Compare «3027».

G2814.def: from «2806»; a limb or shoot (as if broken off):--branch.

G2815.def: of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a Christian:--Clement.

G2816.def: from «2818»; to be an heir to (literally or figuratively):--be heir, (obtain by) inherit(-ance).

G2817.def: from «2818»; heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession:--inheritance.

G2818.et: from (2819) and the base of (3551) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. [reflexively] getting by apportionment)
G2818.def: from «2819» and the base of «3551» (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor:--heir.

G2819.et: probably from (2806) (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose)
G2819.def: probably from «2806» (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose; a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively):--heritage, inheritance, lot, part.

G2820.def: from «2819»; to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege):--obtain an inheritance.

G2821.def: from a shorter form of «2564»; an invitation (figuratively):--calling.

G2822.def: from the same as «2821»; invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint:--called.

G2823.def: of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in:--oven.

G2824.def: from «2827»; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country:--part, region.

G2825.def: from «2827»; a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating):--bed, table.

G2826.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2825»; a pallet or little couch:--bed.

G2827.def: a primary verb; to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively):--bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.

G2828.def: from a derivative of «2827»; properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal:--company.

G2830.et: from kluzo (to billow or dash over)
G2830.def: from kluzo (to billow or dash over); a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively):--raging, wave.

G2831.def: middle voice from «2830»; to surge, i.e. (figuratively) to fluctuate:--toss to and fro.

G2832.def: of Chaldee origin (corresponding to «0256»); Clopas, an Israelite:--Cleophas.

G2833.def: from a primary knao (to scrape); to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle:--X itching.

G2834.def: probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor:--Cnidus.

G2835.def: of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as:--farthing.

G2836.def: from koilos ("hollow"); a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart:--belly, womb.

G2837.def: from «2749»; to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease:--(be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.

G2838.def: from «2837»; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose:--taking of rest.

G2839.def: probably from «4862»; common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane:--common, defiled, unclean, unholy.

G2840.def: from «2839»; to make (or consider) profane (ceremonially):--call common, defile, pollute, unclean.

G2841.def: from «2844»; to share with others (objectively or subjectively):--communicate, distribute, be partaker.

G2842.def: from «2844»; partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction:--(to) communicate(-ation), communion, (contri-)distribution, fellowship.

G2843.def: from «2844»; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal:--willing to communicate.

G2844.def: from «2839»; a sharer, i.e. associate:--companion, × fellowship, partaker, partner.

G2845.def: from «2749»; a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm:--bed, chambering, × conceive.

G2847.et: from (2848) (from the kernel-shape of the insect)
G2847.def: from «2848» (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored:--scarlet (colour, coloured).

G2848.def: apparently a primary word; a kernel of seed:--corn, grain.

G2849.def: from kolos (dwarf); properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction):--punish.

G2850.et: from a derivative of kolax (a fawner)
G2850.def: from a derivative of kolax (a fawner); flattery:--X flattering.

G2852.et: from a derivative of the base of (2849)
G2852.def: from a derivative of the base of «2849»; to rap with the fist:--buffet.

G2853.def: from kolla ("glue"); to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively):--cleave, join (self), keep company.

G2854.et: from a presumed derivative of kollura (a cake - prob akin to the base of (2853))
G2854.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of kollura (a cake; prob akin to the base of «2853»); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster:-- eyesalve.

G2855.et: from a presumed derivative of kollubos (a small coin - probably akin to (2854))
G2855.def: from a presumed derivative of kollubos (a small coin; probably akin to «2854»); a coin-dealer:--(money-)changer.

G2856.et: from a derivative of the base of (2849)
G2856.def: from a derivative of the base of «2849»; to dock, i.e. (figuratively) abridge:--shorten.

G2857.def: apparently feminine plural of kolossos ("colossal"); Colossae, a place in Asia Minor:--Colosse.

G2858.def: from «2857»; a Colossaean, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossae:--Colossian.

G2859.def: apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay:--bosom, creek.

G2860.def: from kolumbos (a diver); to plunge into water:--swim.

G2861.def: a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming):--pool.

G2862.def: of Latin origin; a Roman "colony" for veterans:--colony.

G2863.def: from «2864»; to wear tresses of hair:--have long hair.

G2864.def: apparently from the same as «2865»; the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from «2359»; which properly denotes merely the scalp):--hair.

G2865.et: from a primary komeo (to tend, i.e. take care of)
G2865.def: from a primary komeo (to tend, i.e. take care of); properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain):--bring, receive.

G2866.et: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of (2865) (meaning properly, well dressed, i.e. nice)
G2866.def: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent:--+ began to amend.

G2867.def: from konia (dust; by analogy, lime); to whitewash:--whiten.

G2868.et: from the base of (2867) and ornumi (to "rouse")
G2868.def: from the base of «2867» and ornumi (to "rouse"); pulverulence (as blown about):--dust.

G2869.def: from «2873»; to tire, i.e. (figuratively) to relax:--cease.

G2870.def: from «2875»; mourning (properly, by beating the breast):--lamentation.

G2872.def: from a derivative of «2873»; to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard:--(bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.

G2873.def: from «2875»; a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains:--labour, + trouble, weariness.

G2874.def: from kopros (ordure; perhaps akin to «2875»); manure:--dung(-hill).

G2875.def: a primary verb; to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief:--cut down, lament, mourn, (be-)wail. Compare the base of «5114».

G2876.def: perhaps from «2880»; a crow (from its voracity):--raven.

G2877.et: from a presumed derivative of kore (a maiden)
G2877.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of kore (a maiden); a (little) girl:--damsel, maid.

G2878.et: of Hebrew and Aramaic origin respectively (07133)
G2878.def: of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively («07133»); a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood:--Corban, treasury.

G2879.def: of Hebrew origin («07141»); Core (i.e. Korach), an Israelite:--Core.

G2880.def: a primary verb; to cram, i.e. glut or sate:--eat enough, full.

G2881.def: from «2882»; a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth:--Corinthian.

G2882.def: of uncertain derivation; Corinthus, a city of Greece:--Corinth.

G2883.def: of Latin origin; Cornelius, a Roman:--Cornelius.

G2884.def: of Hebrew origin («03734»); a cor, i.e. a specific measure:--measure.

G2885.def: from «2889»; to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick):--adorn, garnish, trim.

G2886.def: from «2889» (in its secondary sense); terrene ("cosmic"), literally (mundane) or figuratively (corrupt):--worldly.

G2887.def: from «2889» (in its primary sense); orderly, i.e. decorous:--of good behaviour, modest.

G2888.def: from «2889» and «2902»; a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan:--ruler.

G2889.def: probably from the base of «2865»; orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally)):--adorning, world.

G2890.def: of Latin origin (fourth); Quartus, a Christian:--Quartus.

G2892.def: of Latin origin; "custody", i.e. a Roman sentry:--watch.

G2893.def: from kouphos (light in weight); to unload:--lighten.

G2895.def: probably of foreign origin; a mattress:--bed.

G2896.def: a primary verb; properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat):--cry (out).

G2897.def: probably from the same as «726»; properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut):--surfeiting.

G2898.et: diminutive of a derivative of the base of (2768)
G2898.def: diminutive of a derivative of the base of «2768»; a skull ("cranium"):--Calvary, skull.

G2899.def: of uncertain derivation; a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel:--border, hem.
